purpose: Trace-driven pilot only; not a deployment model.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Approximate Caltech/Pasadena location selected to align solar resource with Caltech sessions.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for controlled sensitivity experiments; it is not measured Caltech PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Shared feeder-import budget for controlled congestion; AC validation remains conservative because the IEEE-33 model does not credit the synthetic PV proxy as an AC injection.
